zh_CN: 找到证人，却不能立刻问话
en: Witness found - questions must wait

zh_CN: 你们找到老妇时，刀役与弓役已追到罪坟。女囚让老妇先走，与你留下截住追兵。目标由「寻找老妇」变为「击退追兵，保护证人脱身」：活人能作证，不能让旧账的线索断在这里。
en: You find the gravekeeper as two constables arrive. The prisoner sends her away while you hold them off. FIND the witness becomes PROTECT her escape: repel both pursuers so she survives to testify.

zh_CN: 因住所校勘读懂父亲的编组批注 → 已解锁首轮敌方意图推演。按 F 会先选中一个待行动敌人，可看预计落点、招式、目标和攻击范围；可据此避开射程。仅首轮有效，随站位重算，不增加伤害。
en: Home comparison decoded Father's formation notes: round-one forecasts unlocked. F selects a pending enemy to show its predicted move / skill / target / attack range. Use this to avoid its reach. Recomputed from current positions; no damage bonus.

zh_CN: 未完成住所校勘 → 没有首轮敌方意图推演。仍可按 F 看移动范围，但要自行判断对方会怎样进攻；敌人属性不额外提高，可返回出发前补查。
en: No home comparison: no first-round forecast. F still shows movement range but you must judge the attack yourself. Enemy stats are unchanged. You can return to departure and investigate.

zh_CN: 因码头质证问出西岸近道 → 两名同伴已从更靠近追兵的渡口部署。只改变起始位置，不加攻击或防御。
en: Dock challenge revealed a closer landing: both allies now deploy nearer the pursuers. Only starting positions change; attack and defence do not.

zh_CN: 未问出西岸近道 → 两人从旧坟道部署，接敌需走更远。仍可取胜，不要求穷举调查。
en: No landing shortcut: the party starts on the old grave road with farther to travel. Victory remains possible without exhaustive investigation.

zh_CN: 本场击退刀役与弓役即完成掩护；老妇已先行撤离，不是可受攻击的护送单位。只有确认胜利结算才推进时段。战中 F1 可随时重看目标与情报。
en: Repel both constables to cover her escape. She is already withdrawing; there is no attackable escort unit. Time advances only on confirmed victory settlement. F1 reopens this briefing.

en: Your father died in the false death-record case. You and the prisoner seek the gravekeeper who handled the records. Skipping grants the same index then stops at your first-lead choice. No route / intel / battle is selected for you. J opens the journal later.

zh_CN: 序章 · 一纸亡籍
en: Prologue: A false death

zh_CN: 刑场。父亲跪在台上，你挤过人群喊他。\n他抬眼，却对差役说：「认错了。我没有儿子。」\n差役转头打量你。父亲的手在背后攥紧了。
en: Execution ground. Your father kneels on the platform. You call to him.\nHe looks up: You are mistaken. I have no son.\nA guard turns toward you. Your father's fists tighten behind his back.

zh_CN: 你想再往前，身旁一个带着镣铐的女人忽然撞开差役，拽住你的手腕。\n落令声被人群的惊呼盖住。再回头时，父亲已倒在台上。\n「想活着问清楚，就跟我走！」
en: You push forward. A shackled woman knocks a guard aside and grabs your wrist.\nA shouted order vanishes beneath the crowd. Your father falls on the platform.\nIf you want answers alive then come with me!

zh_CN: 巷口有人掀翻柴车，追兵被堵在后面。女人拖着你穿过窄巷。\n你挣开她：「他为什么不认我？」\n她没有回答，只将你推入一座废祠堂。外面的搜捕声渐渐远去。
en: Someone overturns a cart across the alley to block pursuit. The woman pulls you through.\nYou break free: Why did he deny me?\nShe offers no answer and pushes you into an abandoned ancestral hall. The search moves away.

zh_CN: 祠堂。你认出了她——告发亡籍有假的女囚。\n「是你把我爹送上刑场的！」\n她没有躲：「我只想拿回自己的名字，没想到他们会提前杀人。你可以恨我。但现在，我们都被盯上了。」
en: In the hall you recognize her: the prisoner who exposed the false death record.\nYou sent my father to the execution ground!\nI wanted my own name back. I did not expect them to rush the execution. Hate me if you must. They are hunting us both now.

zh_CN: 女囚：「守墓老妇经手过埋尸记录，知道亡籍上的名字怎样对上坟。她本来要接应我，现在失约了。」\n「我爹的事，她也知道？」\n「我不能保证。但要查他为何卷进去，得先找到一个还活着、经手过旧账的人。」
en: The prisoner says: The gravekeeper handled burial records. She can match names to graves. She was meant to meet me but never came.\nDoes she know about my father?\nI cannot promise. But to find why he was involved we need someone alive who handled those records.

zh_CN: 她递来一张残纸：「河西、七步、三牌、无骨。我还没解开这些记号。」\n你将它夹进随身手册——命卷。它不是另一份神秘名册，只是记录目标、证据和调查结果的地方。\n先按 J 打开看看；Esc 回来后决定第一站。
en: She hands you a scrap: west bank; seven paces; third tablet; no bones. I have not decoded it.\nYou file it in your journal. This is your goals and evidence notebook; not another secret register.\nPress J to inspect it. Return with Esc and choose your first lead.

zh_CN: 你：「我会查清我爹的事。找到她之前，暂且同行。」\n家中可能留有父亲的文书；码头船夫可能见过老妇。\n先选一处即可；路上随时可改去另一处。调查能带来战斗情报，不必把所有选项试遍才出发。
en: I will find out what happened to my father. Until we find her we travel together.\nYour home may hold his papers; the boatman may have seen the gravekeeper.\nChoose a first lead. You can change course later. Investigation earns battle intel; you need not exhaust every option.

zh_CN: 《勘亡录》首条索引
en: First index of the Death Register

zh_CN: 女囚在祠堂交给你的残纸上写着：河西、七步、三牌、无骨。不是完整地址；需要弄清记号的用法。
en: The prisoner's scrap reads: west bank; seven paces; third tablet; no bones. A code rather than a full address.

zh_CN: 预盖空白亡籍
en: Pre-sealed blank death record

zh_CN: 姓名栏尚空，县印却已盖好。边角是父亲惯用的书吏简记：方位—列数—牌数—尸况。便衣编组批注也留在背面。
en: The name is blank but the county seal is already stamped. Your father's notation reads: direction; row; marker; body. Constable formation notes appear on the back.

zh_CN: 找到守墓老妇
en: Find the gravekeeper

zh_CN: 保护守墓老妇
en: Protect the gravekeeper

zh_CN: 已整理女囚交来的索引。可接受寻找老妇的目标。
en: The prisoner's index is recorded. You may take up the search.

zh_CN: 下一步：查住所的文书，或向码头船夫问话。
en: Next: inspect the papers at home or question the dock boatman.

zh_CN: 取得空白亡籍。县印与书吏批注都已记入线索。
en: Blank death record acquired. The seal and clerk's notes are recorded.

zh_CN: 校勘成立：去向是河西罪坟第七列第三牌。父亲的编组批注还解锁战斗情报：首轮按 F 看敌人预计落点、招式、目标与射程，以便避开攻击；不加伤害，首轮后失效。下一步去码头商议出发。
en: Comparison solved: third marker of row seven at the west-bank graves. Father's formation notes unlock round-one forecasts: F shows predicted moves / skills / targets / range to help avoid attacks. No damage bonus. Next: discuss departure at the docks.

zh_CN: 原件已交清籍使团，已知内容仍可查阅。
en: The original is now with the inspector's delegation. Your knowledge remains available.

zh_CN: 祠堂脱身后，女囚交给你的索引还折在衣内。她要找守墓老妇：官府迁坟之前，须弄清那本埋尸簿为何被带走。
en: After escaping the ancestral hall you still carry the prisoner's folded index. She seeks the gravekeeper and the burial ledger before the county moves the graves.

zh_CN: 展开并记录索引
en: Unfold and record the index

zh_CN: 回想此行缘由
en: Recall why you came

zh_CN: 父亲的亡籍疑点尚无答案。老妇经手埋尸记录，可能知道哪些姓名与尸体对不上。先查家里的文书或问渡口的人；不必两边都查才能前进。
en: Your father's records remain unexplained. The gravekeeper may know which names never matched the bodies. Papers at home or witnesses at the ferry offer two leads; either can move the search forward.

zh_CN: 索引的记号难以直接辨认。住所里有父亲旧日的书吏批注；码头的人则可能见过老妇。你准备从哪条线索入手？
en: The index needs interpretation. Your father's clerical notes are at home; the boatman may have seen the gravekeeper. Either lead could help.

zh_CN: 着手寻找守墓老妇
en: Begin the search for the gravekeeper

zh_CN: 旧案边压着一张空白亡籍。纸上的县印与父亲的笔迹挨得很近，唯独本应写着死者姓名的地方空着。
en: A blank death record lies beneath an old file. The county seal sits beside your father's handwriting; only the name is missing.

zh_CN: 取出并检查空白亡籍
en: Take and inspect the blank death record

zh_CN: 重看已记录的批注
en: Read the recorded notes again

zh_CN: 船夫指着铜钉补过的铁牌嘀咕：这种补法，只有守墓老妇会。你问起她近日的去向，他收缆绳的手停了一瞬。
en: The boatman points to a token repaired with a copper nail: only the gravekeeper mends them that way. His hands pause when you ask where she has been recently.

zh_CN: 她近日可曾渡河？
en: Has she crossed the river recently?

zh_CN: 船夫：她三个月没坐过我的船，河西那边不太平。女囚低声提醒：先记住这句「三个月」。质证不是再问一遍，是找出与这句话矛盾的材料，请他解释。没把握就先查看船边的物件。
en: Boatman: She has not taken my boat in three months. The prisoner whispers: Remember that claim. A challenge means presenting a conflicting detail and asking him to explain. Look around the boat first if unsure.

zh_CN: 新近使用的渡船铁牌
en: Recently used ferry token

zh_CN: 验痕还是今日的新印；断角用铜钉补过。船夫方才说，这种补法只有守墓老妇用。你问能否带走这块旧牌，他不耐烦地摆了摆手。
en: The inspection mark is fresh today. A copper nail repairs a broken corner; the boatman said only the gravekeeper mends tokens that way. He waves you away when you ask to keep it.

zh_CN: 船夫的三月未渡说
en: The boatman's three-month claim

zh_CN: 船夫声称：守墓老妇三个月没有渡河。他认得她修补铁牌的手艺，却不愿谈最近的渡客。
en: The boatman claims the gravekeeper has not crossed for three months. He knows her token repairs but refuses to discuss recent passengers.

zh_CN: 重问已经记下的说法
en: Return to the recorded claim

zh_CN: 检查船舷的旧铁牌
en: Inspect the old ferry token

zh_CN: 已记录证言；尚未证实。
en: Testimony recorded; not yet verified.

zh_CN: 取得铁牌；验痕和修补痕迹已记下。
en: Token acquired; inspection and repair marks noted.

zh_CN: 质证成功：船夫承认今晨送老妇去了河西罪坟，并说出西岸近道。去向已确认；出发迎战时，你与女囚会从更近的位置部署。Esc 返回船夫处，选择前往罪坟；情报已记入命卷。
en: Claim corrected: he took her to the west-bank graves this morning and reveals a closer landing. Your party will deploy nearer the enemy. Esc returns to the boatman; choose the grave journey. Intel is saved in your journal.

zh_CN: 出示证物
en: Present evidence

zh_CN: 目标：让船夫解释「她三个月没坐过我的船」。读材料，找时间或人物归属的矛盾；E 出示，不确定可 Esc 回去调查。尝试不耗时。
en: Question his claim: she has not taken my boat in three months. Look for conflicting dates or ownership. E presents an item; Esc returns to investigate. Attempts cost no time.

zh_CN: 这不能核实她最近有没有渡河。说法本身也不能证明说法；需看能对应到人的近期痕迹。不扣时间。
en: This does not verify a recent crossing. A claim cannot prove itself; look for a recent trace tied to her. No time is spent.

zh_CN: 二项校勘
en: Compare two records

zh_CN: 先选一条材料，再选一条可对照的材料。比较记号的含义，不必穷举所有物品。
en: Choose one record and then a relevant counterpart. Compare what the markings mean.

zh_CN: 这两条材料没有共同的记号规则，不能据此解释索引。不扣时间，也不登记事实。
en: These items share no notation that decodes the index. No time is spent and no fact is recorded.

zh_CN: 请选两条不同且已知的材料。
en: Choose two different known items.

zh_CN: 告示附着一个封口收证匣：涉亡籍旧案的原件可投交清籍使团。交出后由使团保管，已记下的内容仍可查阅。你也可以保留原件继续调查。
en: A sealed evidence box sits by the inspector's notice. Originals concerning death records may be submitted to the delegation. They retain custody; your notes remain readable. You can also keep the original.

zh_CN: 预览交付空白亡籍
en: Preview original handover

zh_CN: 接受方：清籍使团。交付：预盖空白亡籍原件。确认后原件不再由你持有；已知内容与事实保留。本周样本不直接翻案、不推进时段，也不把老妇位置写入递呈。此处取消不会交付。
en: Recipient: inspector's delegation. Item: original blank death record. You lose custody but retain knowledge and facts. This sample grants no legal verdict and spends no time; it does not disclose the gravekeeper's location. Cancel to keep it.

zh_CN: 确认投交原件
en: Confirm submission of original

zh_CN: 保留原件，返回
en: Keep the original and return

zh_CN: 预览已失效，原件未交出；请重新查看。
en: This preview has expired. No original was handed over. Review again.

zh_CN: 请到县城街口告示旁的收证匣查看交付。
en: Visit the evidence box by the town notice to preview submission.

zh_CN: 同行女囚
en: The prisoner

zh_CN: 追查迁坟旧账
en: Trace the burial ledger

zh_CN: 抵达罪坟时追兵已到；老妇先撤，我们留下截住刀役与弓役。寻找证人转为保住证人。
en: Pursuers have reached the graves. The gravekeeper withdraws while we hold off the blade and bow. Finding a witness becomes protecting her.

zh_CN: 目标转变：击退追兵，掩护老妇脱身。
en: Objective changed: repel the pursuers to cover the gravekeeper's withdrawal.

zh_CN: 老妇脱险；迁坟旧账成为下一条线索。女囚信任 +1，推进 1 时段。
en: The gravekeeper is safe. The burial ledger is the next lead. Prisoner trust +1; time advances by one slot.

zh_CN: 商议前往河西罪坟
en: Discuss going to the west-bank graves

zh_CN: 女囚：我认得河西旧坟道，没问出近路也能绕过去。到了那里若有追兵，我与你断后，让老妇先走。可先补查；出发后不存战中进度，退出恢复出发前。只有胜利结算才推进一时段。详细情报可查《命卷》。
en: Prisoner: I know the old grave road; we can go without a shortcut. If pursuers arrive we cover her retreat. You may investigate first. No mid-battle saves; leaving restores the departure snapshot. Only settling a victory spends one time slot. Check the journal for intel.

zh_CN: 确认出发；遇追兵则掩护老妇
en: Depart and cover the gravekeeper if pursued

zh_CN: 老妇脱险后只留下一句：迁坟旧账里，埋下的未必都是死人。女囚收好她留下的记号，与你返回码头。下一目标是追查旧账与改籍往事；本周样本到此，不开放后续地区。可查看命卷并存档。
en: After escaping she leaves a warning: not everyone buried in the old ledger was dead. The prisoner keeps her mark and returns to the docks with you. Trace the ledger next; this week's sample ends here with no new region. Review the journal and save.

zh_CN: 下一目标：追查迁坟旧账与改籍往事。本周样本已结束；可回码头听战后对话、查看命卷并存档。后续剧情尚未开放。
en: Next: trace the burial ledger and altered identities. This sample ends here. Return to the boatman for the aftermath; review the journal and save. Further story is unavailable.

zh_CN: 还未结识人物。靠近摊主或船夫交谈后会记入命卷。
en: No acquaintances yet. Speak to the vendor or boatman to record them.

en: Time advanced. The boatman is working elsewhere on this dock; approach him for the aftermath. F5 saves.

zh_CN: 时段已推进，对方去忙别处了。人情变化已记入命卷；请退出面板，在原区域找到对方再交谈。
en: Time advanced and they have moved on. The journal records your ties; close this panel and find them in the same area to talk again.

zh_CN: 走路、阅读和普通交谈不耗时。确认等候才推进一个时段；熟人会更换位置。主线不会因等候被关闭。
en: Walking and reading are free. Confirm waiting to advance one slot. Acquaintances relocate; the main quest stays available.

zh_CN: 本周为日程原型：每循环8槽跨日。正式三日八剧情时段尚未接入；当前不触发封城或截止失败。
en: Schedule prototype: eight clock slots per day. The final three-day / eight-story-phase chapter is not connected. No deadline failure here.

en: No automatic save. Close this panel and use F5 or a manual save slot.

en: Waiting costs one slot and grants no social rewards. Known people stay in their original area but change position and topic.

zh_CN: 搭手帮忙消耗1时段，对方信任+1、乡里声望+1（各自封顶100）。每位熟人每天一次；不奖励武功或主线证据。
en: Helping costs one slot. Trust +1 and town reputation +1 (each capped at 100). Once per person per day; no martial or quest rewards.

en: Unknown

en: Soup stall

en: Street sorting spot

en: Near the tea stall

en: Dock loading spot

en: Distrusted

en: Unknown

zh_CN: 有人称道
en: Well regarded

zh_CN: 对方收住话头，仍对你有些戒备。
en: They hold back and remain wary of you.

zh_CN: 彼此还不熟，只肯谈些眼前的事。
en: You are still strangers; the talk stays close to everyday matters.

zh_CN: 你上回搭过手，这份人情我记着。以后有空再来坐坐。
en: I remember you lending a hand. Stop by again when you have time.

zh_CN: 这些日子多亏你照应。有事尽管开口，别同我见外。
en: You have helped us often. If you need something just ask.

zh_CN: 街坊对你的议论还没散，话也不敢说得太满。
en: People still have doubts about you; I cannot promise too much.

zh_CN: 街坊还不大认得你。行路之外，也可顺手帮人解个难。
en: You are not well known here yet. A small kindness along the way can matter.

zh_CN: 街坊说你肯搭把手。这样的后生，大家愿意多照应些。
en: The neighbours say you help people. They are more willing to look out for you.

zh_CN: 天刚亮，汤还得再熬一会儿。你若赶路，先暖暖手。
en: The sun is barely up and the soup needs time. Warm your hands before you travel.

zh_CN: 早市人多，我得先理好这几筐菜。吃汤的事，待会儿再说。
en: The morning market is busy. I must sort these vegetables before serving soup.

zh_CN: 赶集的人渐渐散了，总算能喘口气。你也歇歇脚。
en: The market crowd is thinning. I can catch my breath; rest your feet too.

zh_CN: 正午这会儿最忙，几桌客人还等着添汤呢。
en: Noon is our busiest time. Several tables are waiting for another bowl.

zh_CN: 午市过了，要把碗盏洗净，免得晚来的人没得用。
en: Lunch is over. These bowls need washing before the evening crowd arrives.

zh_CN: 天将黑，汤还温着。过路的人吃饱了，才有力气回家。
en: Dusk is near but the soup is warm. Travellers need a full stomach for the road home.

zh_CN: 夜市散得慢，灯还不能收。你有事便说，我听着。
en: The night market is slow to close. The lamp stays lit; tell me what you need.

zh_CN: 今晚剩下些收摊的杂活。街上清静了，说话倒方便。
en: Just a little closing work remains. The quiet street makes conversation easier.

zh_CN: 河面雾重，先理缆绳，等看得清了再忙船上的活。
en: Mist lies on the river. I will sort the ropes before tending to the boat.

zh_CN: 晨船刚歇，我在核对货数。不是催你，手边的活得先做完。
en: The morning boat has docked. I am counting cargo; this work needs finishing first.

zh_CN: 日头起来了，这些湿绳得摊开晾。不然下回吃力会断。
en: The sun is up. These ropes need drying or they may snap under strain.

zh_CN: 正午歇一阵。撑船靠的是气力，不是逞强。
en: I rest at noon. Working a boat takes strength; stubbornness is no substitute.

zh_CN: 下午要修补这张旧篷，河上起风，总得有处挡雨。
en: This old awning needs mending. Out on the river we need shelter from rain.

zh_CN: 天色收了，得逐条检查系船的绳结。夜里松开可不是小事。
en: Light is fading. Every mooring knot needs checking before night.

zh_CN: 灯挂好了，岸边还有些零碎货没归拢。我暂不走远。
en: The lamp is hung but some cargo still needs sorting. I will stay nearby.

zh_CN: 夜深船静，正好补补桨柄。有话慢慢说，别惊了歇息的人。
en: The river is quiet. I can mend this oar handle; speak softly for those resting nearby.

zh_CN: 一刻两头：先保文书，还是先保人证？
en: One moment; two leads: papers or witness first?

zh_CN: 女囚：县衙在查抄亡籍经手人的住所，也在传问渡口相关人。你能先保住一处完整机会。读材料、走路和问错证物不会偷偷耗掉机会；开始取证前先作选择。另一线可在救援后补查，但不能把错过的当场协助补回。
en: The county is searching clerks' homes and questioning ferry contacts. Preserve one full opportunity first. Reading and travel are free; wrong evidence does not secretly consume the window. Choose before taking evidence. You may follow up after the rescue but cannot restore assistance missed at departure.

zh_CN: 先保文书：回住所
en: Preserve the papers: go home first

zh_CN: 先保人证：去码头
en: Preserve the witness: visit the docks first

zh_CN: 暂不决定，返回
en: Not yet; return without choosing

zh_CN: 确认这次取证顺序？
en: Confirm this investigation priority?

zh_CN: 你先回住所，争取保全父亲的文书与原件；与此同时船夫会遭传问，可能无法亲自引渡。影响类别：文书原件／渡口协助／战前准备。不会自动发放证物或情报。选择前状态会独立保护；本版尚未开放重勘。
en: You head home to preserve Father's papers and an original. Meanwhile the boatman will be questioned and may be unable to guide you himself. Affects original custody / ferry assistance / battle preparation. No evidence or intel is granted automatically. A separate pre-choice snapshot is protected; replay from it is not available in this build.

zh_CN: 你先去码头，争取在传问前问到船夫；与此同时住所会被查抄，原件转入官府控制。救援后仍可补查来源清楚的摘记，摘记不等于原件。影响类别：文书原件／渡口协助／战前准备。选择本身不授予调查奖励。
en: You visit the boatman before questioning. Meanwhile the home is searched and its original goes into official custody. After the rescue a clearly sourced extract remains available; it is not the original. Affects original custody / ferry assistance / battle preparation. Choosing alone grants no investigation reward.

zh_CN: 确认此次优先行动
en: Confirm this priority

zh_CN: 返回比较，不作决定
en: Back; compare before deciding

en: Choice recorded and saved. Investigate to earn its possible intel.

en: Return to title; discard unsaved progress

zh_CN: 先确认此次取证优先顺序；取消不会锁定路线。
en: Confirm the first-lead priority before investigating. Cancelling locks no route.

zh_CN: 另一处完整机会已经过去。可继续救援；战后能补查，但不会补发首战准备。
en: The other full opportunity has passed. Continue the rescue; later follow-up will not restore first-battle preparation.

zh_CN: 此次选择已确认但尚未保存；请先重试保存，再继续行动。
en: The choice is confirmed but not yet saved. Retry saving before continuing.

zh_CN: 本次进展尚未保存。运行时结果保留；退出前请按F5重试保存，不必重复调查。
en: This progress is not saved. The runtime result is retained. Press F5 before leaving; do not repeat the investigation.

zh_CN: 尚未确定本次取证顺序。选择前会说明影响；命卷只记录你已知和已做的事。
en: No investigation priority chosen. Its effects will be explained first; the journal records only what you know and have done.

zh_CN: 已发生的取舍
en: Recorded choices and consequences

zh_CN: 首次取证：先保文书
en: First lead: preserved the papers

zh_CN: 首次取证：先保人证
en: First lead: approached the witness

zh_CN: 案件阶段：第一日下午 · 首次取证机会
en: Case phase: Day 1 afternoon · first-lead opportunity

zh_CN: 此页是只读记录，不会撤销选择。选择前状态已单独保护；本版尚未开放章节重勘。
en: This is a read-only record; it does not undo the choice. The pre-choice state is separately protected. Chapter replay is not available in this build.

zh_CN: 取舍回顾：文书先行
en: Papers first: aftermath

zh_CN: 取舍回顾：人证先行
en: Witness first: aftermath

zh_CN: 你先保住了文书调查机会，船夫因此已受传问，不能亲自引渡。首战是否看见编组意图取决于出发前有没有完成文书校勘；仅作记录，不补发奖励。
en: You preserved the paper trail while the boatman was questioned and could not guide you. First-round forecasts depended on completing the comparison before departure. This review grants no missed reward.

zh_CN: 你先接触船夫，住所原件同时被收走。首战是否从近处部署取决于出发前有没有用证物争取当场引渡；战后摘记不是原件，也不补发部署优势。
en: You reached the boatman while the home original was confiscated. Closer deployment depended on securing his assistance before departure. A later extract is not that original and restores no missed deployment benefit.

zh_CN: 日程原型
en: Routine prototype

zh_CN: 确认后会自动保存；若写入失败，行动仍已发生。按F5只重试保存，也可返回标题放弃未保存进度。
en: Confirmation saves automatically. If writing fails the action has still happened. F5 retries saving only; returning to title discards unsaved progress.

zh_CN: 下一步：确认先保文书还是先保人证；取消不消耗机会。
en: Next: choose papers or witness first. Cancelling consumes no opportunity.

zh_CN: 下一步：回住所检查文书并对照索引。另一处完整机会已过去；可不取额外情报，直接去码头商议救援。
en: Next: examine the home papers and compare the index. The other full opportunity has passed. You may still go to the docks and start the rescue without extra intel.

zh_CN: 下一步：到码头记下船夫的说法，检查铁牌，再决定是否出示。住所原件已被收走；没有额外情报也能出发救人。
en: Next: record the boatman's claim and inspect the token before presenting evidence. The home original has been confiscated. The rescue remains possible without extra intel.

zh_CN: 下一步：在码头整理女囚带回的尸牌与残页，查清此次救人保住了什么。
en: Next: at the docks examine the grave tag and ledger page brought back by the prisoner. Find what the rescue preserved.

zh_CN: 下一步：读尸牌与残页，对照同一坟号的记载。命卷证据页也能进入墓证校勘。
en: Next: read the tag and ledger page; compare their entries for the same grave number. The journal's Evidence page also opens this comparison.

zh_CN: 下一步：回到码头对话，确认已核实的事实与尚不能断定的部分，记下下一案方向。
en: Next: return to the dock dialogue. Separate the verified fact from what remains unproven and record the next lead.

zh_CN: 本次内测到此。下一案：去旧义庄找真簿与老妇，核对女囚父亲的遗骨。后续地区未开放；可补查、看命卷并存档。
en: Internal test ends here. Next case: find the true ledger and gravekeeper at the old mortuary; verify the prisoner's father's remains. That region is not open. Follow up clues; review the journal and save.

zh_CN: 你：我会查清我爹的事。找到她之前，暂且同行。\n外头传来封门查籍的吆喝。女囚：住所和码头都在被查，你只能先保住一处完整机会。先看两种行动的影响，再确认。\n救人仍有兜底路线；不必猜遍所有证物，问错也不扣时间。
en: I will find out what happened to Father. Until we find her we travel together.\nA search is announced outside. The prisoner says: Both the home and ferry are being checked. Preserve one full opportunity first; review the effects before confirming.\nThe rescue has a fallback route. You need not guess every item; wrong evidence costs no time.

zh_CN: 女囚：我认得河西旧坟道，没有额外情报也找得到她。取证顺序已经决定，错过的完整机会不会在出发前重开。\n遇追兵时我们留下掩护，让老妇先走。出发后不存战中进度，退出回到出发前，但不撤销此次取舍。只有胜利结算才推进一日程槽。
en: I know the old grave road; we can find her without extra intel. Our priority is already decided; the missed full opportunity will not reopen before departure.\nWe will cover her withdrawal if pursued. No mid-battle saves. Leaving restores departure but not the earlier choice. Only victory settlement advances one routine slot.

zh_CN: 没有出发前的文书校勘情报：首轮不显示敌方意图。F仍可看移动范围，敌人属性不提高。错过的原件调查不能在首战前补回；无此情报也能取胜。
en: No pre-departure paper comparison: first-round forecasts are unavailable. F still shows movement range; enemies are not stronger. The missed original cannot be recovered before this battle. Victory remains possible.

zh_CN: 没有争取到船夫当场引渡：两人从旧坟道部署，接敌较远。知道路线不等于有人领路；不提高敌人属性，仍可取胜。
en: No immediate ferry assistance: both allies deploy on the farther grave road. Knowing the route is not the same as having a guide. Enemy stats are unchanged; victory remains possible.

zh_CN: 船夫承认今晨送老妇去了河西，并解释铜钉铁牌的来历。证言和路线已核实；那场救援已经结束，此次补查不改变当时部署，也不会再次推进时段。
en: The boatman admits taking her west this morning and explains the repaired token. Testimony and route are verified. The rescue has already ended; this follow-up changes no past deployment and spends no extra slot.

zh_CN: 县印为何比姓名更早？
en: Why was the seal stamped before the name?

zh_CN: 女囚：若人死了才开亡籍，姓名怎会比县印来得晚？\n你翻到父亲批注：方位、列数、牌数、尸况。索引可能不是行走七步，而是在指某一列、某一块牌。两张纸要对着看。
en: If a death record follows a death then why stamp it before naming the dead?\nFather's margin lists direction / row / marker / body. Seven may refer to a row rather than seven walking paces. Compare the two papers.

zh_CN: 这能证明父亲无罪吗？
en: Does this prove Father's innocence?

zh_CN: 还不能。空白县印说明此案不只是一个书吏随手写错；父亲为何参与、替谁改籍，仍要问经手尸体的人。\n你把疑点和事实分开记下：先找到老妇，不把猜测当成翻案。
en: Not yet. The pre-stamped blank suggests more than one clerk's mistake. It does not explain why Father took part or whose identity he changed.\nYou keep suspicion separate from fact. Find the gravekeeper before calling it a vindication.

zh_CN: 今日验痕，为什么能对应到老妇？
en: How does today's mark connect to her?

zh_CN: 女囚：只看新验痕，最多证明今天有人用过。船夫自己认出了老妇的铜钉补法，这才把痕迹和人连在一起。\n他为何一面认得牌，一面说三个月没见她？若要追问，就把矛盾摆出来；不是拿东西逼他认罪。
en: A fresh mark alone proves only that someone used it today. The boatman himself recognized her copper-nail repair; that connects the trace to her.\nWhy recognize the token yet deny seeing her for three months? Present the contradiction to ask for an explanation; the item alone proves no crime.

zh_CN: 封条压住了门缝。父亲案上的原件已被差役装走，不会因为重进院子而回来。\n桌脚夹着一片旧抄记。这是救援后可以细查的剩余线索，只保存部分内容，不是官封原件；取走它也不会补回已经错过的当场机会。
en: An official seal crosses the door. The papers were carried away; re-entering the yard will not restore them.\nAn old note is trapped under a desk leg. It can be retrieved after the rescue. It preserves only part of the trail and is not an official original; taking it will not restore the missed opportunity.

zh_CN: 战后补查桌脚旧抄记
en: After rescue: retrieve the old note

zh_CN: 了解住所还剩什么可补查
en: What can still be checked at home?

zh_CN: 女囚：住所的原件已经被收走。不过父亲案边也许还有抄记。若想补查，就回住所亲自查看文书处；在码头无法替你取到。旧抄记不是官封原件，也不会补回已经结束的首战准备。
en: The originals were confiscated. Father may have left a copy near his desk. To follow up return home and inspect the papers yourself; nothing can be retrieved from the docks. A copy is not an official original and cannot restore preparation for a battle already finished.

zh_CN: 请到线索原处近距离查看：抄记在住所文书处，补充证言与铁牌要当面向码头船夫取得。
en: Inspect the actual source nearby: the note is at the home desk; the correction and token must be obtained from the boatman at the docks.

zh_CN: 重看已取得的抄记
en: Read the recovered note

zh_CN: 已收起父亲留下的旧抄记。它不等于官封原件，也不补发已结束救援的情报。
en: Father's old note recovered. It is not the official original and grants no intel for the rescue already finished.

zh_CN: 父亲留下的办籍抄记
en: Father's registration note

zh_CN: 救援后在住所桌脚找到，笔迹可辨为父亲：先领印纸，再填亡名；缺尸者另记。它没有县印、原件背面的编组图或完整方位简记。能留下办籍疑点，不能冒充被收走的空白亡籍，也不补发已结束救援的战术情报。
en: Found under the home desk after the rescue; the handwriting is Father's. Take stamped paper first; fill the dead name later; note missing bodies separately. It lacks the county seal and the original's formation sketch and complete location notation. It preserves a question about registration; it is not the confiscated original and restores no past tactical intel.

zh_CN: 船夫拉了拉松开的领口：刚才县衙来人，把每个渡客问了两遍。再替你们领路，我这条船就保不住了。\n女囚：你告诉我们旧坟道朝哪边走就够了，我们自己去。\n他指向西岸，收回了递到一半的船篙。路线可以知道，亲自引渡的机会却已经过去。
en: The county questioned every passenger twice. If I guide you now they will seize my boat.\nThe prisoner says: Point out the old grave road. We will go ourselves.\nHe points west and takes back the pole he almost offered. Directions remain; personal guidance does not.

zh_CN: 救援后补问船夫与铁牌
en: After rescue: follow up the boatman's token

zh_CN: 船夫：你们把人救出来了，我也不能一直装聋。今晨的确是我送她过河；先前若说三月没渡，那是怕查籍。铜钉铁牌也交给你，验痕还能对上。\n你可以把这次补充证言与旧铁牌一起记下，但现在说实话，不会改写当时没有亲自引渡的事实。
en: You saved her; I cannot keep pretending. I took her across this morning. A three-month denial was fear of the registry check. Take the repaired token; today's mark still matches.\nRecord this correction and the old token together. Telling the truth now cannot change that I did not guide you then.

zh_CN: 记下补充证言，接过旧铁牌
en: Record his correction and take the old token

zh_CN: 重看已核实的补充证言
en: Review the recorded correction

zh_CN: 战后补查另一条线索
en: Follow up the other lead after rescue

zh_CN: 他为何没能亲自引渡？
en: Why could he not guide us himself?

zh_CN: 回到码头，女囚解开老妇临走时塞来的布包。人活着走出了追兵的刀口，包里的东西才有机会被核实。\n你先保全文书，船夫却因此遭了传问。若出发前完成校勘，父亲的编组注记已用于那场救援；没有做完，也不会现在补发。先看看保下的尸牌与残页。
en: Back at the docks the prisoner opens the bundle the gravekeeper passed to her while withdrawing. A living witness and her records survived the pursuit.\nYou preserved the papers while the boatman was questioned. If compared before departure Father's formation notes helped in the rescue; unfinished work grants no reward now. Examine the saved tag and page.

zh_CN: 女囚把老妇交给她的布包放到岸石上：先问到船夫，才有争取引渡的机会；有没有拿到协助，要看出发前是否揭开了他的隐瞒。\n住所原件已经被收走，但被收走不等于被烧毁。先核对这次保下的尸牌与残页，战后仍可回去找真实留下的抄记。
en: The prisoner sets down the gravekeeper's bundle. Reaching the boatman first gave you a chance to secure guidance; assistance depended on exposing his concealment before departure.\nThe home original was seized; that does not mean it was burned. Check the saved tag and page. A genuine note can still be sought at home.

zh_CN: 打开布包，记录尸牌与残页
en: Open the bundle; record the tag and page

zh_CN: 取得尸牌与埋尸簿残页。女囚是转交者，原刻与书写者另有其人；两件都还只是待核对线索。
en: Grave tag and burial page received through the prisoner. She is their carrier rather than their maker. Both remain clues pending comparison.

zh_CN: 第七列三号尸牌
en: Row seven; third grave tag

zh_CN: 女囚在撤离时从老妇手里接过。正面新刻第七列三号、女、病亡；背面磨浅的旧字却记无名男尸。坟号相同而姓名与尸况被改过。单看木牌还不能判断是正常重用、错记，还是替人造了一次死亡。
en: Passed from the gravekeeper through the prisoner during withdrawal. Its fresh front reads row seven / third grave / woman / disease. Faint older carving on the reverse records an unnamed man's body. The number stayed while identity and body changed. The tag alone does not distinguish reuse from error or a fabricated death.

zh_CN: 私人埋尸簿残页
en: Page from a private burial ledger

zh_CN: 老妇交给女囚保全的旧页，原藏三号空坟暗格。正文：第七列三号，无骨；真簿移旧义庄。页边另记：旧牌换字，不添新骨。字迹与墨色尚能对照，是否对应同一号尸牌仍须校勘。
en: An old page entrusted to the prisoner by the gravekeeper; formerly hidden in the third empty grave. Row seven; third grave; no bones. True ledger moved to the old mortuary. A margin adds: old tag renamed; no new bones. Compare the number with the saved tag before drawing a conclusion.

zh_CN: 你将两件东西并排放好。一件是能摸到旧刻痕的木牌，一件是写着无骨与真簿去向的旧页。\n女囚：铁牌只能证明她渡过河。现在要问的是——这块尸牌记下的死亡，真有一具对应的尸体吗？
en: You place the tag beside the page. One retains older carving; the other records no bones and the true ledger's destination.\nThe ferry token proves a crossing. This question is different: did the death on this grave tag have a corresponding body?

zh_CN: 翻看尸牌正反两面
en: Read both sides of the grave tag

zh_CN: 细看残页正文与页边记号
en: Read the ledger page and its margin

zh_CN: 墓证校勘：姓名与尸体
en: Burial comparison: name and body

zh_CN: 要核实的是同一个坟号有没有对应尸体。先读材料，再选两件互相印证或冲突的记录；索引给方向，渡船铁牌给行程，不必穷举。不正确的对照不扣时。
en: Check whether the same grave number has a corresponding body. Read first; choose two records that corroborate or contradict each other. The index gives direction; the ferry token gives travel. No exhaustive guessing is needed. Wrong pairs cost no time.

zh_CN: 这组材料还不能对应同一坟号的姓名与入葬。先看哪件记录墓号，哪件说明有没有添新骨；不扣时，也不把猜测登记为事实。
en: This pair does not link the same grave number to a name and burial. Look for a record of the marker and one of whether new bones were added. No time is spent and no guess becomes a fact.

zh_CN: 校勘成立：第七列三号被改记为病亡女子，却没有添入对应尸骨。这一笔亡籍与真实入葬不符；不是证明所有亡籍都假。真簿去向：旧义庄。
en: Comparison verified: row seven's third tag was renamed for a woman without a corresponding new burial. This entry does not match the bodies; it does not prove every death record false. True ledger: old mortuary.

zh_CN: 查看已经核实的墓证结论
en: Review the verified burial finding

zh_CN: 牌号、改字与无骨记载对上了。这不是女囚凭空诬告，也不只是一张纸写错：至少有一次死亡登记，没有对应的新尸体。\n要替父亲翻案，还缺谁下令、为何改籍的证词；要取回她父亲遗骨，还得找真簿。老妇把真簿转去了旧义庄，她为何宁愿冒险带走？
en: Marker number and renaming match the no-bones entry. There was at least one registered death without a corresponding new body; not merely an unsupported accusation or a clerical typo.\nVindicating Father still requires who ordered it and why. Recovering her father's remains requires the true ledger. Why did the gravekeeper risk taking it to the old mortuary?

zh_CN: 这能断言名册上的人都还活着吗？
en: Can we say everyone in the register is alive?

zh_CN: 女囚：不能。真死、假死、换名，可能混在一本册里。我想拿回父亲的骨，不是把所有坟都说成假的。\n你：也不能凭这两件东西就说我爹无罪。先把能证明的这一笔记实，再追问他为何经手。
en: No. Real deaths and false deaths and changed names may share one ledger. I want my father's bones back; I am not claiming every grave is false.\nNor do these two items alone prove Father innocent. Record what they establish; then ask why he handled it.

zh_CN: 记录本段结论与旧义庄线索
en: Record this finding and the mortuary lead

zh_CN: 本段核对完成；下一案指向旧义庄真簿。只结算本次调查，不等于已翻案、取骨或选择最终结局。
en: This investigation stage is complete; the true ledger at the old mortuary is next. This settles only the current inquiry; no vindication or recovery of remains or final ending is granted.

zh_CN: 重看本段尸牌与残页
en: Review this stage's tag and ledger page

zh_CN: 你把结论写进命卷：先保哪条线索改变了调查与救援准备，但没有让真相只剩一种解释。\n女囚：去旧义庄。我要找回父亲的骨；你要问清你父亲为何改籍。先把活人和真簿找齐。\n本次内测到此。后续地区、最终裁定与章节重勘尚未开放；可补查、查看命卷并存档。
en: You record the finding: your priority changed the investigation and rescue preparation but did not reduce the truth to one explanation.\nThe prisoner says: The old mortuary next. I need my father's remains; you need to know why your father changed identities. Find the living witness and true ledger.\nThis internal test ends here. Later regions and final judgment and chapter replay are not available. Follow up clues; review the journal and save.
